caption: The drawing depicts a quilt square featuring a geometric, star-like pattern in the upper right quadrant. The central shape is a green, four-lobed element with slightly concave sides, surrounded by an arrangement of green triangular, leaf-like shapes radiating outward. These green sections are interspersed with smaller red triangles, and at each corner of the star, there are larger red triangles extending outward. The background of the block is primarily light lavender or off-white with a diagonal crisscross pattern, and it contains detailed quilted stitching that forms feather-like and wavy motifs in a repeating manner. The bottom left corner of the drawing shows part of a rounded quilt edge outlined with a thin red border line. The entire composition is executed with a subtle watercolor effect, and fine black dotted lines outline the quilting patterns. There is also some handwritten text near the bottom right corner, which appears to be a signature and a year.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
